name: Eval
description: You are given a simple arithmetic expression of the form a ? b , where a and b are integer constants, and ? can be one of the following operations: ' + ' (addition), ' - ' (subtraction), ' * ' (multiplication), ' / ' (integer division) or ' % ' (modulo operation). output_specification: Output a single integer — the result of evaluation of this expression.
